verdict.rationale: Fern's CLI covers core workflows also available in the UI — initializing, validating, previewing, and publishing docs/SDKs (fern-docs-1) — and every CLI command outputs JSON for agent piping (fern-docs-34), suggesting good API/CLI parity for build workflows. However, several UI-only capabilities (Fern Editor's no-code content editing for non-technical writers, Ask Fern configuration, analytics dashboards, version/domain management) have no documented API/CLI equivalent in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI parity for Fern Editor no-code edits, analytics access, and admin/config actions performed via the web UI.
